```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
library(corrplot)
```


```{r}
precip.chem <- read.csv(here("Data","HBR_PrecChem_1963-2025.csv"))
RG1 <- precip.chem %>% filter(site == "RG1") %>%
  select(site, date, NO3, NH4, Cl)
RG11 <- precip.chem %>% filter(site == "RG11") %>%
  select(site, date, NO3, NH4, Cl)
HDQ <- precip.chem %>% filter(site == "RG22") %>%
  select(site, date, NO3, NH4, Cl)

compare <- left_join(RG1, RG11, by = "date")
hdq.compare <- left_join(RG1, HDQ, by = "date")
```

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(compare, aes(x = NO3.x, y = NO3.y)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey25") +
  geom_point() +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("RG1 (Nitrate)") +
  ylab("RG11 (Nitrate)") +
  ggtitle("Nitrate")

p2 <- ggplot(compare, aes(x = NH4.x, y = NH4.y)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey25") +
  geom_point() +
  coord_equal() +
  ylim(0,7) + xlim(0,7) +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("RG1 (Ammonia)") +
  ylab("RG11 (Ammonia)") +
  ggtitle("Ammonia")

p3 <- ggplot(compare, aes(x = Cl.x, y = Cl.y)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey25") +
  geom_point() +
  coord_equal() +
  ylim(0,4) + xlim(0,4) +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("RG1 (Cl)") +
  ylab("RG11 (Cl)") +
  ggtitle("Chloride")

p1 + p2 + p3 + plot_annotation(
  title = "South-Facing Slope",
  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16)))

ggsave("Chem_Intracompare.jpg")

```

```{r}
precip.vol <- read.csv(here("Data","HBR_PrecVol_1956-2026.csv"))
RG1.vol <- precip.vol %>% filter(rainGage == "RG1") 
RG11.vol <- precip.vol %>% filter(rainGage == "RG11")
HDQ.vol <- precip.vol %>% filter(rainGage == "RG22")

compare.vol <- left_join(RG1.vol, RG11.vol, by = "DATE")
hdq.compare.vol <- left_join(RG1.vol, HDQ.vol, by = "DATE")
vol.all <- precip.vol %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "rainGage", values_from = "Precip") %>%
  mutate(DATE = as.POSIXct(DATE)) %>%
  filter(DATE >= "1997-01-05" & DATE <= "2014-12-31") %>%
  select(-RG18, -DATE)

vol.nozero <- vol.all[rowSums(vol.all != 0) > 0, ]
```

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(compare.vol, aes(x = Precip.x, y = Precip.y)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey25") +
  geom_point() +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_classic() +
   ylim(0,150) + xlim(0,150) +
  xlab("RG1") +
  ylab("RG11") +
  ggtitle("South-Facing Intercompare")

p2 <- ggplot(hdq.compare.vol, aes(x = Precip.x, y = Precip.y)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey25") +
  geom_point() +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_classic() +
   ylim(0,150) + xlim(0,150) +
  xlab("RG1") +
  ylab("Headquarters") +
  ggtitle("South-Facing vs HDQ")

p1 + p2 + plot_annotation(
  title = "Rain Volume",
  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16)))

ggsave("Vol_Compare.jpg")

```


```{r}

corr1 <- round(cor(vol.all), 3)

corrplot(corr1, order = 'hclust', addrect = 3)



png("CorrPlot.png", width = 800, height = 800, res = 120)

corrplot(corr1, 
         is.corr = FALSE, 
         col.lim = c(0.9, 1), 
         cl.lim = c(0.9, 1),
         order = 'hclust', addrect = 3)

dev.off()


```
